0.original: Houu has a nose for noxious happenings in the spawning grounds─especially where the Coral Tridents are involved.

1.original: Maelstrom recruits have been captured by the Coral Tridents, and rendered helpless by noxious gas from paralysis pots. Houu has given you stoppers to use on the pots.

2.original: The stoppers proved to be a perfect fit, and the reeling recruits are back on their feet and out of the Sapsa Spawning Grounds. Report the successful mission to Houu.

3.original: A Sahagin of peace, Houu reveals that he is caught between two faiths. He would not deny Leviathan his rightful oblations, but would not have a war fought over the “drowning” of shorewalkers, either. It is unfortunate that your two peoples will yet be caught up in this struggle for the foreseeable future...

24.original: Use pot stoppers on paralysis pots in the Sapsa Spawning Grounds.

48.original: Pshhh... The waves bring news of shhhorewalkers held captive by the Coral Tridents. They are of the Maelstrom─mere recruits.

49.original: They are certain to be “drowned”─their minds twisted by Leviathan's aweshhhome powers. Unleshhh something is done, the Maelstrom may feel it necessary to shhhtrike back. Go to their rescue, shhhorewalker.

50.original: Deep within the shhhpawning grounds, you will find them lying insensate. The gas shhhpewing forth from the Tridents' paralysis pots comes from noxious barnacles, and it renders them helpleshhh.

51.original: Pshhh... Use these shhhtoppers to plug the pots stationed by the recruits. They should come to shhhortly thereafter once the air clears.

52.original: Use the shhhtoppers on the paralysis pots to restore the captive shhhorewalkers to their shhhenses. But beware the Coral Tridents along the way... Pshhh...

56.original: Llymlaen... Halone... Thaliak... I...I can't remember which god to call to...

57.original: Ungh... I'm not... What's...? What in the Navigator's name am I doing? We have to get out of here!

58.original: Wh-Where am I!? What is this!? We were attacked! Taken by the Sahagin! Must! Report!

59.original: What a dream! Home, before the Calamity. Had it pretty good, didn't I? But my home's with the Maelstrom now... I'd better get back.

60.original: Adventurer, you have saved my sanity! Those cursed fishbacks would part me from mine own mind!

62.original: The captive shhhorewalkers swim free? Good... The drowned have their place, for Lord Leviathan must have His due, but...

63.original: Shhhorewalkers are a vengeful people. For every Maelstrom won for Lord Leviathan, there will be retribution in kind and more. Not worth the trouble, I shhhould think. Pshhh...

64.original: (-Shelfclaw Guard-)Pshhh! You dare take what belongs to Lord Leviathan!?

65.original: (-Shelfclaw Guard-)Another shhhoul that shhheeks to be drowned! Your innermost wish I shhhall grant!

66.original: (-Shelfclaw Guard-)The Coral Tridents take no prisoners! Well, except this lot. But never you mind that─prepare to die!
